name: templates-gallery
body: Templates gallery page (/templates): renders each template of the deck's merged library (the external library at the configured `templates:` path when set, and the deck-root `templates/` directory; see layered-template-library) from its example and documentation, and documents a template's declared child sections — and, for a section template, the child sections it can hold — each with what it accepts (cli-templates-show). A tree view of a template's nesting (its composed child sections, recursively) is a nice-to-have, not a required behaviour.
